headline: Portfolio Outperformance vs. SPY YTD
summary: As of October 20, 2026, the portfolio set is outperforming SPY, with an average return of 25.05% compared to SPY's 13.49%. This outperformance translates to an average alpha of 11.56%, indicating that the portfolios are not only gaining in absolute terms but are also exceeding the benchmark. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has delivered a notable return of 36.42%, significantly contributing to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned only 1.71%, highlighting a disparity in performance across the portfolio set. This relative strength against SPY is particularly relevant during periods of market uncertainty, as it suggests resilience in the portfolio's composition. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
